VC2CCPAC1: Cross-curriculum idea: First Nations societies are diverse, with their own languages, customs and beliefs.
VC2CCPAC2: Cross-curriculum idea: First Nations peoples have their own distinct ways of living, knowing and thinking.
VC2CCPAC3: Cross-curriculum idea: First Nations cultures are the oldest living cultures on Earth and are kept strong and renewed.
VC2CCPACP1: Cross-curriculum idea: First Nations communities are deeply tied to, and care for, Country and Place, land, sea and sky.
VC2CCPACP2: Cross-curriculum idea: British colonisation under terra nullius had lasting effects on First Nations Peoples.
VC2CCPAP1: Cross-curriculum idea: Australia has two First Nations Peoples, each made up of many nations.
VC2CCPAP2: Cross-curriculum idea: First Nations Peoples have sophisticated social, political and economic systems.
VC2CCPAP3: Cross-curriculum idea: First Nations contributions are recognised locally, nationally and globally.
VC2CCPASG1: Cross-curriculum idea: Australia's ties with Asian peoples shape culture and citizenship.
VC2CCPASG2: Cross-curriculum idea: Australia and Asia are connected through past and present links.
VC2CCPASK1: Cross-curriculum idea: Peoples of Asia are diverse in culture, history, beliefs and language.
VC2CCPASK2: Cross-curriculum idea: How people interact with Asia's environments has global effects.
VC2CCPASU1: Cross-curriculum idea: Asian nations influence world affairs past and present.
VC2CCPASU2: Cross-curriculum idea: Asian peoples contribute to the arts, sport, science, technology and more.
VC2CCPSFT1: Cross-curriculum idea: Sustainable futures thinking weighs possible and desirable futures to guide action.
VC2CCPSFT2: Cross-curriculum idea: Sustainable futures value fairness across communities and generations.
VC2CCPSFT3: Cross-curriculum idea: Sustainability needs creative thinking, research, reflection and collaboration.
VC2CCPSIS1: Cross-curriculum idea: All life depends on Earth's connected systems.
VC2CCPSIS2: Cross-curriculum idea: Sustainable living means using resources responsibly and keeping air, water and soil healthy.
VC2CCPSIS3: Cross-curriculum idea: Economic, social and cultural systems affect Earth's sustainability.
VC2CCPSRD1: Cross-curriculum idea: Responsible design reduces harm to the environment and restores it.
VC2CCPSRD2: Cross-curriculum idea: Responsible design considers unexpected future consequences.
VC2CCPSRD3: Cross-curriculum idea: Responsible design respects land custodianship and balances past and new knowledge.
VC2CCPSWV1: Cross-curriculum idea: Worldviews shape action and play a key role in sustainability.
VC2CCPSWV2: Cross-curriculum idea: Worldviews form from personal, local and global experiences.
VC2CCPSWV3: Cross-curriculum idea: Sustainable worldviews consider effects on future generations.
